user.title: Connect to Veyra
user.description: Enter only the Veyra IP/hostname and web port. Cameras, MQTT topics and model classes are discovered automatically.

abort.already_configured: This Veyra instance is already configured.

init.title: Veyra notifications
init.description: Select Home Assistant Companion devices. Veyra forwards the native prealert, confirmed and repeat lifecycle. Repeat remains enabled and its cadence is controlled by CORE; the integration does not mute or rate-limit valid alarms.
